question: Who won India's first-ever medal in the men's 50m Rifle 3-Positions final at the Paris 2024 Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swapnil Kusale**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Swapnil Kusale won India's first-ever medal in the men's 50m Rifle 3-Positions final at the Paris 2024 Olympics.
 
• He achieved this historic feat by showcasing exceptional skill and precision in the event.
 
• The 50m Rifle 3-Positions event includes shooting in three different positions: kneeling, prone, and standing.
 
• Swapnil Kusale's victory is a significant milestone for Indian shooting sports, highlighting the country's growing talent in this field.
